description: Header file defining the OStringStream class, a custom string stream implementation optimized for appending to a user-specified std::string, part of the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: OStringStream
classes.description: A custom string stream class that appends to a user-provided std::string, offering performance improvements over std::ostringstream.

classes.name: OStringStream::Streambuf
classes.description: A nested stream buffer class used internally by OStringStream to manage string output.

methods.name: OStringStream::str
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal std::string used by the stream.

methods.name: OStringStream::str (const version)
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the internal std::string.

methods.name: OStringStream::str (setter)
methods.description: Sets the internal std::string to the provided pointer.

methods.name: OStringStream::Streambuf::overflow
methods.description: Handles overflow when the buffer is full, appending characters to the string.

methods.name: OStringStream::Streambuf::xsputn
methods.description: Writes a sequence of characters to the string buffer.
